## Summary

Describe the behavior or documentation changed.

## Linked issues and milestone

- Fixes #ISSUE_NUMBER (or `None` if no issue applies)
- Target release milestone: `vX.Y.Z` (or `None`)

## Verification

Provide actual tests run, evidence, or a clear reason they do not apply.

## Security and privacy

Describe credential, personal-data, dependency, and production-data impact.
Confirm no private XML or secrets are included.

## Release impact

- [ ] Release notes updated, or no new release notes needed
- [ ] Upgrade and compatibility impact documented, or none
- [ ] Signed commits and protected-main CI verified
